title: Preparation of live cell samples for fluorescence spectroscopy and computational super-resolution imaging
protocol: Wipe the biosafety cabinet thoroughly with 70% ethanol.
Spray and wipe down all items taken inside the cabinet with 70% ethanol.
Warm all media and solutions to 37°C in a water bath before use.
Culture CHO-K1 cells in DMEM supplemented with 1% penicillin-streptomycin and 10% FBS at 37 °C in a 5% CO₂ environment.
Remove the spent media from the culture flask and discard.
Wash the flask twice with 5 ml PBS (without Ca²⁺ and Mg²⁺).
Add 2 ml Trypsin-EDTA (1X) to the flask and incubate at 37°C for 5-15 minutes.
Add 5 ml of culture media containing serum to the flask to inhibit trypsin.
Collect the media containing the detached cells in a falcon tube.
Centrifuge the collected media at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 5 ml PBS.
Count the cells using a cell counter.
Aliquot the required number of cells into falcon tubes and centrifuge at 200 × g for 3 minutes.
Discard the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in R buffer.
Mix suitable amounts of plasmids with the cells for transfection.
Electroporate the cells using Neon Transfection system according to the manufacturer’s protocol (pulse voltage = 1,000 V, pulse width = 30 ms, and pulse no. = 2).
Seed the cells onto glass bottom culture dishes containing DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS; no antibiotics.
Incubate the cells at 37°C and 5% CO₂ for 36-48 hours before experiments.
Observe the cells under a fluorescence microscope to check for fluorescence and determine whether the transfection was successful.
Remove the spent media from the cells.
Wash the cells 2-3 times with 1X HBSS.
Add DMEM not containing phenol red (Imaging DMEM) to reduce background fluorescence.
If cell starvation is required, do not supplement the Imaging DMEM with FBS.
If a 5% CO₂ environment cannot be maintained on the microscope setup, supplement the Imaging DMEM with HEPES.
The transfected cells can now be used for experiments.
Prepare suitable concentration of the drug or ligand in Imaging DMEM and add the solution to the cell culture dish.
